title: Add FileNode.spaceId extension and chat-filenode role
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00 extends FileNode with spaceId (String, immutable) and defines role urn:jmap:chat:filenode:space for Space file tree roots. The filenode crate has no chat awareness. Need spaceId as extension field and register the role value.
notes:
